body.prompt: OLD DOG: the same golden-yellow nureongi now old and big, a grey-white muzzle, slightly cloudy eyes, a faded red collar. UMBRELLA: a child's bright yellow umbrella with one small white heart hand-painted on one panel. Many years later, autumn rain on the muddy village road with rice paddies. No people in this shot. The old dog walks slowly carrying the folded yellow umbrella with the white heart in its mouth, its cloudy eyes half closed; Kachi flies just ahead of its nose at eye level, guiding it along the road toward the stone school gate in the distance. Kachi is about the size of the dog's head. The magpie is exactly the character in the magpie reference image: a small round chibi magpie with a glossy black head, cream-white face and belly, big shiny dark-brown eyes, short black beak, dark navy-blue wings, a red knotted neckerchief and a small brown leather satchel. It does NOT hold a microphone. Style: handcrafted 3D miniature diorama photographed with a macro lens, tilt-shift, shallow depth of field, soft cinematic light, felt, clay, paper and wood textures with tiny hand-painted details, gentle film grain, warm nostalgic color grade, clay figurines with soft rounded faces and gentle, restrained, understated expressions (no tears, no crying, no exaggerated sad faces), not photorealistic. Vertical 9:16 frame, main subject in the middle of the frame, a calm uncluttered area in the top fifth of the frame. Absolutely no text, no letters, no numbers, no hangul, no logos, no labels, no brand names, no watermark anywhere.
